message: No detected input validation: The code loads CSV files and passes them directly into processing without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards beyond what pandas implicitly does.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths via pd.read_csv with no remote source fetching, checksum verification, or authentication of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs filtering, merging, and column dropping but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or any mechanism to identify and remove suspicious/poisoned training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: The code uses `load_serialized` which loads pickle files directly with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before deserializing.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or anomalous training samples before or during training; only general exploratory analysis (null checks, zero counts, unique values) is performed.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any stress-test routines are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation strategy, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation in the evaluation flow.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads serialized models and datasets via pickle/CSV without any shape, range, type, or schema validation on incoming data before passing it to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There is no code visible that checks model predictions for NaN values, out-of-range outputs, or any sanity bounds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML regressors (GradientBoostingRegressor, SVR, etc.) and is not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
